declarations.name: AuiPopover
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Popover on its trigger:
`<button [auiPopover]="filters" popoverTitle="Filters">Filters</button><ng-template #filters>...</ng-template>`.
The template is rendered as an embedded view, so its bindings stay live.

inputs.name: popoverTitle
inputs.description: Visible heading; names the popup through aria-labelledby. Either title or label is required.

inputs.name: popoverLabel
inputs.description: aria-label when there is no title.

inputs.name: popoverPlacement
inputs.description: Preferred side and logical alignment; flips and shifts to fit.

inputs.name: popoverOffset
inputs.description: Gap between trigger and popup, px.

inputs.name: closeOnEscape
inputs.description: Escape requests close (cancelable). Escape is consumed while the popover is topmost either way.

inputs.name: closeOnOutsidePointer
inputs.description: Pointer down outside the popup and trigger requests close (cancelable).

inputs.name: initialFocus
inputs.description: Where focus goes on open: first tabbable element (falls back to the container), the popup container, or nowhere.

inputs.name: showCloseButton
inputs.description: Render a localized close button in the header.

outputs.name: opened
outputs.description: After the popup opened (dispatched on the popup element).

outputs.name: cancelled
outputs.description: Before a user-initiated close; preventDefault keeps it open.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Hide the popover; focus returns to the trigger.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Show the popover when hidden, hide it when shown.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Disclosure (trigger) with a non-modal Dialog (popup).

limitations: The trigger should be a native <button>: Enter and Space activation relies on the native click. Other elements need their own keyboard activation.
The popup is inserted immediately after the trigger, so it inherits the trigger's container styles such as `dir` and font; it is not portaled.
The heading is always an h2.
Close animation is not played; the open fade uses @starting-style and is removed under reduced motion or `animation: 'none'`.
Canceling aui-cancel for a focus-out close leaves the popup open while focus is elsewhere.
